title: A garden beyond the court
text: Saheliyon Ki Bari is associated with Maharana Sangram Singh and the women of the royal household. Fountains, lotus pools and marble pavilions give the garden a different character from the palace interiors. The design brings water and garden architecture together, making leisure itself part of the city’s heritage.

title: Water as garden architecture
text: At Saheliyon Ki Bari, water is part of the garden’s structure rather than an addition to it. Pools, fountains and marble elements organise what visitors see and hear. Following the paths between them offers a quieter way to experience royal design than moving through a sequence of indoor galleries.
